title: news scores propose
description: Fit new weights from the labels since the live scorer version (a Bradley–Terry fit: weights ≥ 0, summing to 1, each moving at most 0.05) and store them as the open proposal; prints the diff. Input is the command's arguments as an object; output is the envelope's data.

version.description: The proposed version, adopted with `news scores adopt` (G tier)

parent.description: The live version it was fitted from

held_out.description: Labels kept out of the fit (every fifth)

agreement_before.description: Kendall's tau of the live weights on the held-out labels

agreement_after.description: Kendall's tau of the proposed weights on the held-out labels
